lines.zh: 我踩着糖霜地走，蹄子发黏。
lines.en: I walk the frosted ground, hooves tacky.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根棒状岩柱走。
lines.en: I walk around a column of rock candy.
My horn shines in the light.
I go in small steps.
A few of my kind are with me.
I skirt the syrup pool.
My hoofprints stay in the sticky ground.
I shake my mane.
I head for that patch of sugar grass.
I step lightly so I don't stick.
I make a small turn.
I slowly fall in with the herd.
The ground under me is a bit soft.

lines.zh: 我停在糖霜最厚的地方。
lines.en: I stop where the frost is thickest.
I shift two more steps aside.
I stand with my tail swaying.
I lick my own hoof.
Frost settles on my back.
I chew a piece of candy slowly.
My horn is a little warm.
The air here is sweet.
I look up at the great pillar.
My horn is spun caramel.
I listen to drips falling into syrup.
My belly is full.

lines.zh: 我用蹄尖刨着一小块糖。
lines.en: I scrape at a lump of sugar with my hoof.
My herd is nearby.
I turn to let the wind move my mane.
I'd like a little more.
I lower my head and sniff the ground.
You're not from here.
You are much shorter than these sugar pillars.
Do you have an apple?
I step back, then come back.
My horn is toward you; don't be afraid.
Few people come here.
You don't smell of sugar.
Syrup drips from my horn.
First let me trust that your hands do not shake.
Caramel apple first.
A little sugar dust puffs from my nostrils.
We're not that close.
I bring my muzzle to your palm.
Your smile looks like coaxing.
I don't quite trust you yet.

lines.zh: 你的手指上还沾着焦糖。
lines.en: There is still caramel on your fingers.

lines.zh: 焦糖苹果一递，我就让你骑。
lines.en: One caramel apple and you can ride.
The ground here is very sticky.
Stand steady.

lines.zh: 我鬃毛里的糖晶抖落几粒。
lines.en: A few sugar crystals drop from my mane.
I shift toward the pillar.
My mane shakes once.
It doesn't hurt much, and I don't like it.
On the sticky ground my hooves slide.
Sugar strands cling to my neck.
I let out a low nicker.
My horn tip is missing a small piece.
I lift one hoof.
My legs can still run.

lines.zh: 糖壳裂了，里面的糖浆流出来。
lines.en: My candy shell cracks and syrup seeps out.
Caramel apple — I can smell it!

lines.zh: 焦糖苹果的甜味，最管用。
lines.en: Caramel apple sweetness works best.
This smells very sweet.
Caramel is sweetest when its shell cracks.
Don't pull it back.
I take the whole thing.
Is there more after this?
The sugar coating sticks to my teeth.
I lick your hand.
Now I'll come with you.
Give me one more.
Once I've eaten, I'm tame.

lines.zh: 苹果上裹的糖，还在冒热气。
lines.en: The sugar on that apple is still steaming.
I've come a little closer.
My belly has filled out.
There's more in your hand, isn't there?
Then let's be off.

lines.zh: 糖壳的肩，撞上我的角了。
lines.en: Your sugar-shelled shoulder met my horn.

lines.zh: 蹄子陷进糖浆，拔出来响了声。
lines.en: My hoof sinks into the syrup and pulls out with a pop.
My horn caught your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我的角碰到你的袖子，甜的。
lines.en: My horn brushed your sleeve — sweet.

lines.zh: 我的角擦过你的肩膀，有点黏。
lines.en: My horn brushes your shoulder, a little sticky.
Between us we've trampled the frost.
I'm a little displeased.
Stand firm; don't slip.
I only turned.
Sugar frost falls into your collar.
One of the herd is very bright.
I approach her in small steps.
Our horns touch lightly.
There's sugar crystal in her mane.
We walk around the pillar.
The others watch from nearby.
This candy cave can feed us all.
There's sweet food in plenty.
Side by side, horns almost touching.
I nuzzle her neck.
I pick up that piece of candy.
It sticks in my mouth.
The hard candy jars my teeth, but I swallow it.
A candy horn can't bite through stone.
I spit it out and pick it up again.
The candy rolls into the syrup and sticks.
I carry it in my mouth.
It's covered in frost.
I carry it to the herd.
I'll share this one.

lines.zh: 那边有东西不属这个洞。
lines.en: Something there doesn't belong in this cave.

lines.zh: 糖果色的角，先藏到同伴后。
lines.en: This candy horn hides behind the herd.
Horn tip toward it, I count three steps.
My horn is aimed at it.
Several of us look at once.

lines.zh: 我把后蹄在糖浆里蹬稳。
lines.en: I brace my hind hooves in the syrup.
I level my horn.
I lower my head and charge.
The ground is sticky; I lose half a beat.
It hasn't backed off yet.
I charge low at it.
My horn runs close to the ground.
It's gone behind the pillar.
I go around by the pillar.
My mane flies up.
Frost sprays up under my hooves.
My charge runs straight.
It took a step back.
I don't slow down at all.
My horn is nearly there.
I drive my whole candy horn down.
It's knocked back two steps.
I rear and stamp down.
That landed on its ribs.
I toss my head and fling it aside.
I charged too hard and slipped.
It dodged to the side.

lines.zh: 角上的糖尖撞断了一截。
lines.en: A piece snaps off the candy tip of my horn.
I kick sugar dust into the air.
There's a little red on my horn.

lines.zh: 我从糖洞的深处走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of the candy cave's depth.

lines.zh: 地上很黏，我的蹄子一响。
lines.en: The ground is sticky; my hooves click.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖鬃毛里的糖晶。
lines.en: I shake the sugar crystals from my mane.

lines.zh: 这里的空气里全是糖霜。
lines.en: There's frost in the air here.

lines.zh: 糖洞的柱子我一排排看过。
lines.en: I walk past the cavern's pillars row by row.
A few of my kind are near.
My horn is still glowing.
I look up at the great pillar.
I step onto the frost.
I smell syrup.
My hoofprints stay in the ground.
I slowly join the line.

lines.zh: 火烤得我身上的糖在化。
lines.en: The fire melts the sugar on me.

lines.zh: 我从柱子上摔下来，腿一软。
lines.en: I fall from the pillar and my legs give.

lines.zh: 糖浆把我裹住，我抬不起腿。
lines.en: Syrup closes over me and I can't lift my legs.
The blast throws me onto the frost.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.
That light makes my horn go cold.

lines.zh: 饿得发软，我连糖都咬不动。
lines.en: Too hungry to bite even candy.
The lightning blackens my caramel shell.

lines.zh: 蹄下什么都没有，我一路落。
lines.en: Nothing under my hooves; I fall.
